_doc: Identity-lock references and account links for Biscuit. `bin/studio seed` upserts the character and its accounts from this file. status: designing | live | paused (the daily run skips anything but live; flip to live at go-live). An account with a null handle is not seeded yet (planned_handle is the first choice of docs/launch/social-pages.md, shown on the terminal until the real handle replaces it); an account with no postiz_integration_id is skipped by planning. dropin_share is the first-insert value (1.00: Drop-in is the default for every video, owner decision 2026-10-05): the Instagram guard and the terminal change it later and a re-seed leaves it alone. traits is the character's trait card (see studio/seed.py): the terminal shows it, its props are the Make-it chips and the daily run scores fit against it. closeup_center / blue_eye_xy are pixels of the 1080x1920 close-up (centre of the push-in) and of the screen at the outro zoom 1.3 (where the glint sits).
